issues: Playwright reports browser title as 'Emergent | Fullstack App' — this is the Emergent preview environment iframe wrapper overriding the tab title. The actual <title> tag in /app/frontend/public/index.html is correctly set to 'StreamVault Admin'. Not a real app bug.

critical_code_review_comments: roku.py confirm-link: customer['id'] field is used in link update (user_id) but the customer document uses MongoDB _id internally. The code works because customers were created with an explicit 'id' field, but if any customer was created without an 'id' field, customer.get('id') would be None silently. Safe as-is given current customer creation flow.
roku.py get_db(): Creates its own MongoClient instance (_client) separate from server.py's global client. This works but means two connection pools exist. Minor resource inefficiency — not a bug.
guide-app/src/config.js uses 'http://localhost:8001' as fallback for REACT_APP_API_URL. Must be overridden at build time for production Docker deployment.

TVGuide.jsx Sidebar nav items: 'Settings' is not in Sidebar.jsx for guide-app (only 7 items: Home, Guide, On Demand, Recordings, What's New, Saved, Live TV). The main frontend Sidebar.jsx has Settings. This is correct per the guide-app design (no admin access from TV guide), but the main frontend test request mentions 'Settings' should be visible — it is, in the main frontend's Sidebar.
